user.title: Connect Sonos MCP
user.description: Connect the official Sonos MCP server. Home Assistant registers an OAuth public client automatically; no client secret is needed. Continue, then sign in to Sonos and review the requested permissions. Setup only loads the tool list; it does not start playback or change speakers.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Sonos MCP
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to Sonos again to restore access to the existing connection.

error.cannot_register: Could not register the OAuth client with Sonos. Check internet access and try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Authorization completed, but Home Assistant could not connect to the Sonos MCP server.
